interpretation.causalConclusion: Unknown. The structural findings do not establish why Defender rejected the fixture.
interpretation.testConclusion: 2218 tests passed and one native integration test failed during child creation. This is not a completely passing suite or a successful deferred-breakpoint runtime validation.

recommendation: Retain the original blocked-fixture identity and targeted host records; leave protection and the rejection intact.
Record this native integration case as a host-blocked verification gap. Continue reporting deterministic admission and encoding tests separately from actual native execution.
Do not vary payloads/hashes, obfuscate, add exclusions, disable protection or retry the rejected executable to obtain a passing result.

If this test is redesigned for ordinary maintainability later, prefer reviewed native C/assembler source and a standard x86 compiler/linker, with separate RX code and RW data/import storage, verified labels and normal PE metadata. A redesign would still require independent security acceptance and runtime validation; no such redesign or launch was performed here.
